title: VIXEN catalog preflight should validate the paired Undertow error fragment
body: The initial queued VIXEN configure selected the main Undertow checkout for its provider discovery, but the requested composed error catalog needs tools/error-catalog/UndertowErrorCatalogFragment.cs and the main checkout did not contain it; the same configure also stopped at libraries/Text because its generated transpiled/textshader interface was absent. Recovery set UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/errorcatalog5a, which supplied both the generated text interface and the catalog fragment. Make the paired-provider preflight derive or validate the Undertow fragment alongside schemas.json and the text-shader inputs, so a catalog consumer does not need a lane-specific environment override.
